Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please review the following core technical specifications and scholarship on digital facsimiles:

  • IIIF Consortium. IIIF Image API 3.0 and IIIF Presentation API 3.0. International Image Interoperability Framework, 2023. [Open Access]
  • Snydman, Michael, Robert Sanderson, and Tom Cramer. "The International Image Interoperability Framework (IIIF): A Community-Driven Solution for Digital High-Resolution Image Delivery." Archiving Conference, 2015.
  • TEI Consortium. "Representation of Primary Sources: Digital Facsimiles." In TEI P5 Guidelines, Chapter 11. TEI Consortium, 2024.
  • Cayless, Hugh, et al. "Multimodal Manuscript Representation Toward an Open Repository for Manuscript Research." Digital Humanities Quarterly, 2023.
